articles.title: Dozens of people saved from rubber boat off southern Netherlands coast
articles.description: Dozens of people adrift at sea in a rubber boat have been rescued off the coast of the southern Netherlands. The Marechaussee military police and Netherlands coast guard rescued the boat early Saturday morning. It had no motor and was drifting off the coast of Zeeland province. There were 38 people on board, including two who have been detained on suspicion of people smuggling. None was wearing a life vest. It’s unclear where the people came from or were heading. Those on board were taken to dry land and checked for hypothermia.

articles.title: Snowfall and clouds may slow East Antarctic ice loss in a warmer world
